value: Industrial, public and commercial steam boilerhouses (gas, heavy/medium fuel oil, distillate oil and coal) surveyed for overall fuel-to-steam thermal efficiency, including standby, low-load, blowdown and boilerhouse losses.

process: Boilerhouse energy surveys, 300 boilers at over 100 UK sites, all fuels (Table 1)

UK energy surveys of 300 boilers at over 100 sites; survey date not stated (guide first printed 1997, revised 2003).

process: Boilerhouse energy surveys, gas-fired boilers (Sect. Results of the energy surveys)
value: Gas-fired steam boilers in the UK boilerhouse surveys, the fuel group with the highest average efficiency owing to better turndown, lower excess air, cleaner and newer boilers and the use of economisers.

process: Boilerhouse energy surveys, gas-fired boilers (Sect. Results of the energy surveys)
note: Average overall boilerhouse thermal efficiency of gas-fired steam generation in the surveys. HHV (gross calorific value); the guide notes gas has around 3% higher inherent loss than oil and coal on a gross basis. Averages for coal, heavy/medium fuel oil and distillate are shown only as lines on Figure 2 (see _other-values).

process: Modern steam boiler, operated correctly (Sect. Thermal efficiency of steam generation)

value: Surveyed boilerhouses with the full recommended package of measures (combustion adjustment, blowdown heat recovery, oxygen trim, economisers, sequencing controls, isolation dampers, boiler replacement, fuel conversion).

process: Boilerhouse energy surveys, after all recommended measures, all fuels (Sect. Energy saving potential)
